quote: HOUSTON, April 15, 2024—SLB (NYSE: SLB) has been awarded three contracts by Petrobras (NYSE: PBR) for completion hardware and services for up to 35 subsea wells in the development of Petrobras’ offshore Buzios Wave II oilfield. The scope of the contract includes SLB’s full bore electric interval control valves and electric subsurface safety valves.
note: Opened SLB English primary 15 Apr 2024; CapEx blank. Distinct from SLB Atapu/Sépia completions.
